description: Free. Returns the full text of one DEOS Open standard (when to use it, the rules, how to run it, done when, common failures, template), with its link, version and license, and the JSON Schema link for the four that have one (C1, C3, C5, C13). Use it to follow a standard exactly rather than from memory.

id.description: The standard's id, e.g. "C1" (Decision Record), "C13" (Six-Lens Board), "R3" (Category Entry Point Read).

name: get_standard
title: Read one DEOS Open standard
